<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/reports/freshness"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The freshness lag of the projection the report reads: `as_of` is the
CloudEvents time of the newest event the projector has applied and
`lag_seconds` is now minus `as_of` (never negative). Both are null
until the first event is applied. A growing lag means the projector is
down or behind, not that the report is wrong: it catches up when the
projector does.
